ValidationRule.description: The First Bill Date and Close Date cannot be a past date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(IM_Booked_Date__c < today(),CloseDate < today()), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, '1 - Qualification'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '2 - Solution Developed'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '3 - Solution Agreed'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '4 - Negotiate')), QTB_APIProcess__c = false, $Profile.Name <> "IM_Sales Ops Super User" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The First Bill Date and Close Date cannot be a past date.
